name: Consecration
description: Holy light hallows the ground in a 15-foot Emanation around you for the duration. When you cast the spell, pick any number of creatures; each of them that starts its turn inside the Emanation takes 1d8 Radiant damage. Fiends and Undead treat the area as Difficult Terrain.
eli5: Hallow the ground within 15 feet of you so creatures you pick take 1d8 radiant damage when they start their turn there, and Fiends and Undead treat it as Difficult Terrain.

name: Guided Prayer
castingTrigger: which you take when you become Bloodied or when you take damage while Bloodied
description: You call on the Light in your moment of need. You regain Hit Points equal to 8d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and you have Advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of your next turn.
eli5: As a reaction when you become Bloodied or are hurt while Bloodied, heal yourself for 8d4 plus your spellcasting modifier and gain Advantage on your next attack roll.

name: Divine Shield
castingTrigger: which you take when you take damage
description: A shell of radiant light closes around you until the start of your next turn. Until then you have Immunity to all damage, including the damage that triggered this spell. Your Speed can't be reduced, any reductions already affecting you are suspended, and nothing can move you against your will.
eli5: As a reaction when you take damage, become immune to all damage, including the triggering hit, and you cannot be slowed or moved against your will until your next turn.

name: Curse of Agony
description: You lay a festering curse on one creature you can see within range. The curse's damage starts at 1d4 Psychic. The target makes a Constitution saving throw at once and again at the end of each of its turns while the spell lasts. On a failed save, it takes the damage and the die grows one size, from d4 to d6, d8, d10 and at most d12. On a successful save, it takes the damage at its current size and the spell ends.
eli5: Curse a creature to take 1d4 psychic damage now and at the end of each of its turns, growing one die size up to d12 on each failed Constitution save and ending on a success.

name: Freezing Trap
description: You set an invisible, intangible trap of frost at a point you choose within range. The first time a creature comes within 5 feet of that point, the trap bursts with frost and the spell ends. That creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Restrained condition for 1 minute. Taking any damage ends the Restrained condition on it early.
eli5: Set an invisible frost trap that restrains the first creature to come within 5 feet of it for 1 minute on a failed Constitution save, until it takes any damage.

name: Serpent Sting
castingTrigger: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a weapon
description: Venom floods into the creature you just hit. It takes an extra 4d6 Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d6 Poison damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.
eli5: Right after a weapon hit, deal an extra 4d6 poison damage and poison the target, which takes 2d6 more at the end of each of its turns until it passes a Constitution save.

name: Explosive Trap
description: You set an invisible, intangible trap at a point you choose within range. The first time a creature comes within 5 feet of that point, the trap explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point, and the spell ends. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 8d6 Fire damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, is pushed 20 feet straight away from the center of the Sphere.
eli5: Set an invisible trap that explodes in a 20-foot radius when a creature comes within 5 feet, so each creature there that fails a Dexterity save takes 8d6 fire damage and is pushed 20 feet.
